name: ER-Telecom Ermak modular data center, Perm
notes: Kommersant reported ER-Telecom's plan for a Perm modular data center with 10 separate modules, 8,320 racks and 35 billion rubles investment; secondary trade coverage says the Perm and Moscow flagship sites are planned at up to 50 MW each, with first phase targeted for Q1 2028.

name: Rucolo.ru Data Center, Perm
notes: Directory listing identifies an operational Perm data center at Ulitsa Popova 9 with two equipment rooms and 68 cabinets; directory reports 0.5 MW. No primary operator announcement found in this pass.

name: Key Point Vladivostok / Nadezhdinskaya data center
notes: DCD reported Key Point launched the first phase in Primorsky Krai near Vladivostok with 440 racks and full build-out planned at 880 racks / 10 MW; DataCenterMap lists Vladivostok-1 as commissioned in February 2023 with 2.2 MW IT capacity and 3.6 MW design capacity.

name: Areal-Pskov data center, Moglino SEZ
notes: Pskov regional government reported the Moglino SEZ expert council supported Areal-Pskov's plan to build a specialized 20 MW data processing center on the SEZ site.

name: Key Point Rostov Region data center
notes: Interfax reported a signed Innoprom-2024 agreement for Key Point to build a Rostov Region data center costing about 4 billion rubles, with planned capacity of 800-1,000 racks; MW not disclosed.

name: Yandex Sasovo data center
notes: Sintec project page identifies Data Center Yandex in Sasovo, Ryazan region, for customer LLC Yandex DC; DCD later described Sasovo as one of Yandex's five operating Russian data centers. Directory confirms Yandex Cloud Sasovo listing. MW not confirmed by a primary source in this pass.

name: Almazergienbank extreme-climate data center, Yakutsk
notes: ComNews and Infosystems Jet reported commissioning of a Tier 3-resilience data center for Almazergienbank in Yakutsk, designed for operation from -60C to +40C; capacity not disclosed.

name: YATEK natural-gas-powered data center pilot, Vilyuysky District
notes: IT Russia reported Russia's first natural-gas-powered data center entered pilot phase in Yakutia's Vilyuysky District, initiated by Yakut Fuel and Energy Company; capacity not disclosed in accessible source text.

name: Rostelecom Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk data center
notes: Rostelecom put the Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk data center into commercial operation; initial capacity 1.5 MW and 25 rack spaces, expandable to 180 rack spaces.

name: Key Point Sakhalin data center
notes: Rostelecom announced cooperation with Key Point for Sakhalin IT infrastructure; regional reporting said a Tier III Key Point commercial data center with 850 kW capacity was expected on Sakhalin. Later completion evidence was not found in this pass.

name: MegaFon Samara Data Center
notes: MegaFon announced the Samara Tier 3 data center opening on 8 October 2010; project facts list 6,912 sq m, six server halls, 900 million rubles investment and an 8 MW power system.

name: Rostelecom Samara data center
notes: Commercial data center directories list a Rostelecom Samara colocation site at Ulitsa Sadovaya 292. Capacity and commissioning date were not confirmed by primary sources in this pass.
